game.title: Wolfenstein: Youngblood
game.blurb: Co-op first-person shooter from Bethesda Softworks, Arkane Studios and Machine Games (as RAWG lists them), released 2019-07-26. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Finishing every mission, plus the hidden story milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Three Brothers
chapters.summary: Defeating the Übergarde in Brother 1, Brother 2 and Brother 3.

chapters.title: Playing Together
chapters.summary: Missions with a co-op partner, revives and pep signals.

chapters.title: Collectibles, Crates and Undergrounds
chapters.summary: Supply crates, red crates, the Dunwall souvenir, cassette tapes, readables, floppy disks, 3D glasses, UVK covers, coins, code locks and the Undergrounds.

chapters.title: Abilities, Upgrades and Armour Skins
chapters.summary: Weapon upgrades, a fully upgraded weapon brand, abilities and power armour skins.

chapters.title: Weapon Mastery
chapters.summary: Mastery level 10 with each weapon, and with all of them.

chapters.title: Combat Feats
chapters.summary: Kill counts with stealth, explosives, thrown weapons, take-downs, dual-wielding, the Crush ability and against Supersoldaten and drones.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has no page under "Wolfenstein: Youngblood" or "Wolfenstein Youngblood". wolfenstein.fandom.com answers the API under "Wolfenstein: Youngblood" with about 168 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 1056960 was used; the app list also has "Wolfenstein: Youngblood Deutsche Version" (1057810), which was not used. 7 of 60 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the story chapter; "God mode" (3.3%) and "Vive la révolution!" (24.9%) may be harder unlocks rather than plain story. "Partisan" (Complete all missions, 6.4%) was put with the story.
